summary_en: ¥8.8B authorization, 4,000,000 shares (8.5% of 47.1M ex-treasury), acquisition period Aug 3–Dec 30, 2026, open-market method, own funds. Acquired shares to be fully cancelled.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Riken Technos' board of directors resolved on 31 July 2026 to authorize acquisition of up to 4,000,000 treasury shares (8.5% of the 47,105,105 shares outstanding ex-treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥8.8 billion during the period 3 August to 30 December 2026. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase funded by operating cash. The company intends to cancel all acquired shares. The authorization supports flexible capital management and improved capital efficiency in response to changing business conditions.
